skill.summary: Query Taipei parking availability, lot details, pricing, and reported charger status using public feeds without API keys.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: Eighteen findings are false positives involving Markdown, public parking feeds, JSON reads, and parking identifiers. Two download commands use predictable shared temporary paths, enabling local file overwrite through preexisting symlinks. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or concealed executable content.

remediation.issue: Downloads write to predictable shared temporary paths at SKILL.md lines 25 and 35.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with mktemp -d, store both feeds inside it, and update jq paths. Clean up after use.

content.value_statement: Drivers need current parking availability and clear lot details before choosing a destination. This skill joins public Taipei feeds to report spaces, addresses, pricing, and update times.
actual_capabilities: Fetch Taipei parking availability and static lot descriptions without an API key or login.
Match lots by place or name and join both feeds using parking-lot identifiers.
Report vehicle-specific availability and distinguish missing data from full lots.
Provide lot addresses, pricing text, service hours, and capacity where reported.
Report charger status for lots that include charging-station records.
Include feed update times and filter district results by available car spaces.
limitations: Coverage is limited to Taipei parking lots; other cities and roadside spaces are excluded.
Availability depends on feed freshness and network access; spaces are not reserved or guaranteed.
Some lots lack live counts or charger records; -9 means no data for that vehicle type.
Shell examples require curl and jq; distance calculations require converting TWD97 coordinates.

use_cases.title: Choose a parking lot before driving
use_cases.description: Find lots around a named Taipei destination and compare reported spaces, addresses, and pricing.

use_cases.title: Check parking and charger status
use_cases.description: Review car availability and reported charging-station status for matching Taipei lots.

use_cases.title: Compare district parking options
use_cases.description: Summarize lots with available spaces in a Taipei district, including update times and missing-data notes.

prompt_templates.title: Check one parking lot
prompt_templates.prompt: Check current car availability for [parking lot name] in Taipei. Include its address and the feed update time.

prompt_templates.title: Compare district options
prompt_templates.prompt: List up to ten parking lots with available car spaces in [Taipei district]. Include counts, addresses, and update times.

prompt_templates.title: Review vehicle and charging data
prompt_templates.prompt: Find lots around [Taipei place]. Compare reported car spaces, motorcycle spaces, pricing, and charger status. Mark missing fields clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Build a validated parking comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Join both Taipei feeds by lot identifier for [district]. Rank car availability numerically, include timestamps, distinguish -9 from zero, and flag stale data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: feed reconciliation and data quality

output_examples.input: Show an example parking result for Changchun in Zhongshan District.
output: Historical example, not current availability: Taiwan Unicom Changchun Parking Lot, No. 17, Changchun Road, Zhongshan District.
The skill documents 15 available car spaces on September 19, 2026.
A live query must fetch the feed and include its UPDATETIME.

output_examples.input: The feed shows -9 for motorcycle spaces. Is the lot full?
output_examples.output: No. The value -9 means motorcycle availability is not reported for this lot. It does not mean zero spaces.

output_examples.input: Find current roadside parking spaces in Taichung.
output_examples.output: This skill covers Taipei parking lots only. It cannot report Taichung availability or live roadside parking spaces.

best_practices: Include the availability feed update time and label historical examples clearly.
Treat -9 as missing data and check vehicle-specific fields before comparing lots.
Use private temporary files for downloads and verify successful retrieval before parsing.
anti_patterns: Presenting historical counts or stale downloads as current availability.
Treating -9 as a full lot or assuming every lot reports charger status.
Applying Taipei feeds to other cities or interpreting TWD97 coordinates as latitude and longitude.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses public Taipei parking feeds without authentication.

faq.question: Which locations are covered?
faq.answer: The feeds cover Taipei parking lots. Other cities and live roadside spaces are not supported.

faq.question: What does -9 mean?
faq.answer: It means no availability data exists for that vehicle type. It does not indicate a full lot.

faq.question: Does every lot report EV charger status?
faq.answer: No. Only some availability records include charging-station status. Missing records must be labeled as unavailable.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee a space when I arrive?
faq.answer: No. Counts reflect the feed update time and may change before arrival. The skill cannot reserve spaces.

faq.question: What tools and access are required?
faq.answer: The documented workflow needs network access, curl, and jq. Use private temporary files instead of the example's predictable shared paths.
